subject.title: auth probe: token-type profile not counted as effective for claude-cli provider (TUI stuck on 'auth expired')

question: Should OpenClaw accept the linked PR's OAuth-first, token/setup-token-fallback policy as the canonical fix for this auth-status bug?
rationale: The code path is a compatibility-sensitive provider auth-status rule, and the open PR is already the concrete fix candidate with proof; resolving the issue depends on maintainer acceptance or rejection of that policy.

options.title: Accept linked PR policy
options.body: Review and land the linked PR if maintainers agree that token/setup-token profiles should satisfy the status rollup when no effective OAuth profile exists.

options.title: Revise the policy in the PR
options.body: Ask the PR to adjust the gateway/auth-health boundary if maintainers want a different interaction between OAuth expectations, token credentials, and explicit auth order.

options.title: Reject the linked PR and keep issue open
options.body: Close or pause the PR only if maintainers want a different fix path, leaving this issue open as the canonical bug report.

recommendation.title: Accept linked PR policy
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR if maintainers agree that token/setup-token profiles should satisfy the status rollup when no effective OAuth profile exists.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to this issue and has the strongest token-auth/setup-token feature-history signal.
